desc: It's time to bring out the big guns. The 110 Magnum Target is built to pull maximum range and precision from the 300 PRC & 338 Lapua Magnum cartridges. It features user-adjustable Competition AccuTrigger technology, and the 26-inch, heavy carbon steel barrel is button rifled and perfectly balanced with the gray wood laminate stock. The rifle offers a muzzle brake, oversized bolt handle and the redesigned 110 action.
